map.选择犬（按玩具/小型/中型/大型体型区分）或猫，输入宠物实际年龄，工具换算为对应: Select a dog (by toy/small/medium/large size) or a cat and enter the pet's real age; the tool converts it to the matching human age and labels the life stage (juvenile, adult, senior) so owners understand the pet's physiological and care stage.
map.领养/救助年龄判断：流浪犬猫常不知确切生日，用估算年龄换算人类岁数，帮助判断已进: Adoption and rescue age judgment: stray dogs and cats often have no known birthday, so convert an estimated age into human years to help judge whether they are already senior (a large dog at 6 years is about 45 in human years or more) and adjust feeding and checkups.
map.老年病筛查时机：犬猫老年期（犬 7 岁 / 猫 8 岁起）对应人类中老年，建议每: Senior screening timing: the senior period for dogs and cats (dogs from 7, cats from 8) matches middle and older adulthood in humans, so a checkup every six months is advisable; the conversion can plainly tell owners "it is equivalent to a human of XX years".
map.体型差异：大型/巨型犬老化更快，同是 5 岁，小型犬≈人类 36 岁、巨型犬≈4: Size differences: large and giant dogs age faster, so at the same 5 years a small dog is about 36 in human years while a giant dog is about 45, and checkup and joint care schedules differ.
map.算例：5 岁中型犬 / 5 岁猫: Worked examples: a 5-year-old medium dog / a 5-year-old cat
map.为什么大小犬换算系数不同？: Why do the conversion factors differ between large and small dogs?
map.大型犬成熟更快、寿命更短，老年病（关节、心脏）出现更早，故体型越大「每年对应人类: Large dogs mature faster and live shorter, and age-related disease (joints, heart) appears earlier, so the larger the dog the more human years each dog year corresponds to (small +4, medium +5, large +6, giant +7); this model is a general approximation and not an exact physiological age.
map.年龄换算能直接用于用药/疫苗吗？: Can the converted age be used directly for medication or vaccines?
map.不能。换算仅帮助理解衰老程度与养护重点；疫苗、驱虫、用药剂量须按体重、健康状况与: No. The conversion only helps you understand the degree of aging and the care priorities; vaccines, deworming and drug doses must follow body weight, health status and the veterinarian's plan. This tool does not replace professional care.
